verification.notes: FAA registration records confirm that N1098L, a 2023 Bombardier Global 6500 (serial 60098), is registered to LASAI Aviation II LLC. The legacy claim text abbreviated/transposed the owner as “LSAI,” while the transcript itself spells L-A-S-A-I. The canonical statement uses the official registered name; the original wording and verification history remain preserved in legacy provenance.
